steps.content: You run your hand over the surface of the wall. It's definitely not a prop.
You look down and see a round object on the ground where the shadow figure disappeared a minute ago.
You pick it up. It's a wind-up toy, probably from one of the toy shops on the street, with a funny-looking face.
It likes this kind of toy?
While you were chasing it in the shopping street, you did notice how it was easily distracted by the toys behind display windows.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: What a creative design. Gotta get Daddy to buy it for me.

steps.speaker: Black Shadow
steps.content: Ahhh! There's more of them. How I wish I could take them all home!
You're fairly certain that the shadow figure saw something it liked in the shopping street. Judging by its behavior, it should be drawn to collect novel things and new experiences.
An idea comes to you. But you're not sure if it'll work.
You decide to go ahead with it anyway, since there seems no better option at this point.
You're going to set a special trap for this playful ghost.
